ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows the contour distribution of the daily mean value of multi-year average cloud amount in Southwest China and adjacent regions. B is located in the southern and eastern part of the figure. The contour values nearby are relatively high and arranged relatively densely, and the contour lines show an obvious northward bend near B. The area where B is located roughly corresponds to the southeastern edge of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, the Hengduan Mountains, and the vicinity of the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau. Then reason: The question requires judging the most important influencing factor for the northward bending of the contour line at B. This region has large terrain relief; plateaus and mountains have uplifting and blocking effects on water vapor, which can significantly change the local cloud amount distribution, causing contour lines to deviate from the general latitudinal distribution and bend. Therefore, the most important factor is topography.

method.method_draft: 先从图像读取：乙位于我国西南部，附近多年平均云量等值线较密集，并在乙地一带明显向北凸出；该处大致处在青藏高原东南缘—横断山区、云贵高原附近。再从题干读取：问题要求解释“乙地等值线向北弯曲”的最主要影响因素。把乙地位置与中国地形分布相联系：西南地区地势起伏大，高原、山地对水汽抬升、阻挡和局地云量分布影响显著，常导致等值线偏离纬向分布并发生弯曲。因此判断主要因素为地形。
